name: Moon Observatory Melanie
source:
This story centers on Melanie's task to apparently save the world, a role given to her by the mysterious Magician Ven. However, it seems as if he isn't telling her everything...

Melanie's "partner-in-crime" Shisui is the only one who seems to realize, but at the same time wants to preserve her innocence.

Melanie runs head-first into the world with accepting arms, while Shisui curses it for forcing a cruel fate on Melanie.

[Edited from [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#upcoming]Moon Observatory[/url]]
translation:
故事圍繞梅拉妮肩負的使命展開：神秘魔法師Ven交給她一個任務，看起來是要她拯救世界。然而，他似乎對她有所隱瞞……

梅拉妮的「共犯」Shisui似乎是唯一察覺到這一點的人，卻又希望守護她的天真。

梅拉妮張開雙臂，義無反顧地擁抱這個世界；Shisui卻詛咒這個世界，因為它強加給梅拉妮如此殘酷的命運。

[根據[url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#upcoming]Moon Observatory[/url]編輯]
